title: Software Engineer
description:
**About PQStation**

PQStation is a post-quantum cryptography company spun out of NTU Singapore. Large organizations run on cryptography they can't fully see: certificates, TLS configurations, libraries and keys spread across thousands of systems. Before they can move to quantum-resistant algorithms, they need to know what they have.

Our platform, QVision, finds the cryptography in use across networks, hosts and certificate infrastructure. It produces a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) that security teams can act on. We work with banks, telcos and government agencies in Singapore and the region.

**The role**

This is a full-time, remote position. You'll build and ship QVision. That includes the sensors that find cryptography in production environments, the services that turn raw findings into an inventory, and the tooling that deploys it inside regulated customer environments.

**Typical work includes:**

* Writing and extending discovery sensors in Rust
* Building back-end services and APIs (Python, Postgres, Redis, Celery) that model and query cryptographic inventory
* Packaging and deploying to customer Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters, often under strict security constraints
* Turning research from our NTU team into production code
* Reviewing code, writing tests and docs, and joining design discussions

**You may be a fit if you have**

* 2+ years building and running production back-end systems
* Strong skills in Rust, Python or Go, and willingness to work in the others
* Experience with APIs, relational databases and queue-based processing
* Working knowledge of Linux, containers and Kubernetes
* A habit of testing carefully and reviewing code closely
* Comfort working remotely and owning problems end to end

**Nice to have**

* Applied cryptography experience: TLS, X.509/PKI, or HSMs (PKCS#11)
* Network traffic analysis (Zeek, packet capture)
* Experience deploying into banks, government or other regulated environments
* Familiarity with the NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)

Equivalent experience counts as much as a degree.

**Details**

* Location: Remote (Asia-Pacific time zones)
* To apply: careers@pqstation.com, with a short note on:

1. What does a TLS handshake reveal about the cryptography a server uses, and what does it hide?
2. Tell us about a time you turned a vague or research-heavy requirement into working code.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar, including complex state machines with conditional routing, parallel execution, and error recovery patterns.
* Architect graph-based agent workflows with 10+ nodes involving agent collaboration, task decomposition, and sequential/parallel execution across multiple business domains.
* Develop and maintain reusable agent node libraries, extensible platform patterns, versioning strategies, and testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end) for agent workflows.
* Build production-grade FastAPI applications with async I/O patterns, integrating PostgreSQL, Redis, and external enterprise services.
* Implement real-time agent streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket protocols, alongside RESTful and event-driven API architectures for agent orchestration.
* Integrate cloud-based LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4) and design prompt management systems with versioning, templating, and dynamic compilation.

description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy
**production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives**
**.**
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building Teradata’s
**vector store and retrieval infrastructure**
, powering
**RAG, multimodal AI, agentic workflows, and semantic search**
at enterprise scale.

**LLMs, information retrieval, and distributed systems**
**,**
and wants to work on
**core platform capabilities**
, not just application demos.

* Design and implement vector store capabilities integrated with Teradata’s analytics platform, including indexing, storage, retrieval, and query optimization.
* Build end-to-end RAG pipelines, including:
* Data ingestion and chunking strategies
* Embedding generation and lifecycle management
* Retrieval (dense, sparse, and hybrid search)
* Context assembly and prompt orchestration

* Enable multimodal RAG (text, structured data, images, etc. ) and agent-based workflows.

* Implement guardrails for safety, reliability, and governance (hallucination mitigation, rounding, policy enforcement).

* Collaborate with product, research, and platform teams to translate customer use cases into scalable features.
* Benchmark Teradata’s vector store and RAG capabilities against industry alternatives (e. g. , cloud and open-source solutions).
* Contribute to technical design reviews, architecture decisions, and long-term AI platform strategy.

You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers, and domain experts
**at Silicon Valley**
, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.
* Domain specialists to ensure solutions align with real-world business problems in regulated industries.
* Infrastructure and platform teams responsible for training, evaluation, and scaling AI workloads.

This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company.
  
  
This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
* 3+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend systems.
* Hands-on experience with vector databases or vector search systems.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, especially RAG systems
* Strong understanding of:
* Embeddings and similarity search
* Data chunking and context optimization
* Dense vs sparse vs hybrid retrieval
* Semantic search and relevance ranking
* Proficiency in Python (and/or Java); experience with production-grade systems.
* Experience working with large-scale data and performance-sensitive systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with multimodal embeddings and retrieval.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent).
* Experience implementing AI guardrails and evaluation frameworks.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with distributed systems or analytics platforms.

We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

* Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, optimize performance, and support testing and deployment activities.
* Utilize source control, update set management, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices to support application lifecycle management.

* Produce clear technical documentation, development standards, and implementation artifacts.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards.

* Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform capabilities, and application development best practices.
* Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree
* Certification in ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong JavaScript development skills and proficiency with ServiceNow scripting APIs and development frameworks.
* Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspace development.
* Certifications in any of the following:

+ ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
+ One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, or other product areas)
+ ITIL Foundation Certification

* Experience building and supporting REST/SOAP integrations and API-based solutions.
* Knowledge of platform security, application scoping, ACLs, and governance best practices.
* Experience with CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, or Service Mapping is preferred.
* Familiarity with source control, Git, update sets, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of ITIL concepts and enterprise service management processes.
* Experience developing across multiple ServiceNow product areas is highly desirable.
* Ability to lead technical solution design while mentoring other developers.

These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Senior Manager - AI & IT
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  
ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
  
  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.

description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
Director, AI & Information Security
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Define and maintain enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* Architect and govern secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Establish and enforce Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* Lead the development of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* Design enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* Oversee SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* Develop robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* Conduct comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* Provide architectural guidance during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* Education Requirements: B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).

title: Principal Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.
  
  
Our office is in Bellevue, WA, but we offer flexibility for eligible candidates to work remotely across the West US. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere .
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and hands-on contributor, designing and optimizing high-scale, distributed storage systems built on AWS storage technologies. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture, performance, and reliability of backend storage solutions that power critical applications at scale.
  
  
Your primary responsibilities will include designing, implementing, and optimizing backend storage services that support high throughput, low latency, and fault tolerance. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to drive scalability, availability, and efficiency improvements in large-scale storage solutions. You will also lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and root cause analyses to resolve complex production issues related to storage performance, consistency, and durability.
  
  
As a thought leader, you will drive best practices in distributed system design, security, and cloud cost optimization. You will also mentor senior engineers, contribute to technical roadmaps, and help shape the long-term storage strategy. Your expertise in storage consistency models, data partitioning, indexing, and caching strategies will be instrumental in improving system performance and reliability.
  
  
Additionally, you will collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to implement observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring high availability and compliance with industry standards. You will advocate for automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and DevOps best practices, leveraging tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable deployments and operational excellence.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Basic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of experience in backend software development, focusing on distributed systems and storage solutions.
* 5+ years of experience working with AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier).
* Strong expertise in system design, architecture, and scalability for large-scale storage solutions.
* Proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python).
* Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient storage architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, replication strategies, sharding, and caching.
* Knowledge of data security, encryption best practices, and compliance requirements (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical roadmaps.
* Proficiency with observability tools, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale.

**Core Requirements**
**Expertise in Large-Scale Storage Systems**

* Deep knowledge of AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier) and their performance characteristics.
* Experience designing and optimizing object storage, block storage, and file storage solutions at scale.
* Strong understanding of storage durability, consistency models, replication, and erasure coding for fault tolerance.
* Experience implementing tiered storage solutions and cost-optimized data retention strategies.

**Distributed Systems & Scalability**

* Deep understanding of distributed storage architectures, CAP theorem, and consistency models.
* Expertise in partitioning, sharding, and replication strategies for low-latency, high-throughput storage.
* Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems using consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos, Gossip Protocol).
* Hands-on experience with high-performance NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, RocksDB).

**High-Performance Backend Engineering**

* Strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python for backend storage development.
* Experience building event-driven, microservices-based architectures using gRPC, REST, or WebSockets.
* Expertise in data serialization formats (Parquet, Avro, ORC) for optimized storage access.
* Experience implementing data compression, deduplication, and indexing strategies to improve storage efficiency.

**Cloud-Native & Infrastructure Automation**

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud storage best practices.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
* Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda, Fargate), and containerized storage workloads.
* Expertise in CI/CD automation for storage services, leveraging GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.

**Performance Optimization & Observability**

* Experience with benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing storage workloads.
* Proficiency in performance monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for storage systems.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and concurrency issues.
* Experience designing observability strategies (tracing, metrics, structured logging) for large-scale storage systems.

**Security, Compliance, and Data Protection**

* Deep knowledge of data security, encryption at rest/in transit, and IAM policies in AWS.
* Experience implementing fine-grained access controls (IAM, KMS, STS, VPC Security Groups) for multi-tenant storage solutions.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and best practices for secure data storage.
* Expertise in disaster recovery, backup strategies, and multi-region failover solutions.

**Leadership & Architectural Strategy**

* Proven ability to design, document, and drive large-scale storage architectures from concept to production.
* Experience leading technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.
* Strong ability to mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering growth in distributed storage expertise.
* Ability to influence technical roadmaps, long-term vision, and cost optimization strategies for backend storage.

title: QA Specialist / SDET
description:
**Quality engineering for a specification-driven world**

At Bosenet, software is increasingly built through a cycle of
**Understand → Specify → Design → Delegate → Generate → Review → Test → Validate → Improve**
. Requirements are written as structured specifications and significant parts of the implementation are produced with AI coding agents — which changes what testing means. Quality can no longer be inspected in at the end of a sprint; it starts at the specification, where ambiguity is cheapest to remove and where a sharp question from a tester prevents an entire class of defects.

We are looking for a hands-on QA specialist who is comfortable in the room when specs are being discussed, who designs their own test strategy rather than executing someone else's, and who is evolving towards an
**AI-native development lifecycle (AIDLC).**

**What you will do**

• Own the test strategy, methodology and quality approach for your products and integrations — you define it, you are not handed it.

• Take part in specification and design discussions, and ask the questions that expose ambiguity, missing acceptance criteria, unstated assumptions and edge cases before code is written; push back where a specification is not testable.

• Design and maintain automated suites with
**Playwright and/or Selenium**
— functional, regression, cross browser and end-to-end — plus
**API and integration automation**
for REST services, microservices, event driven workflows and SaaS integrations.

• Run sharp exploratory and risk-based manual testing where automation is not the right instrument.

• Wire tests into
**CI/CD pipelines**
so quality signals arrive continuously, not at release time.

• Review AI-generated code and AI-generated tests critically — correctness, coverage gaps, silent assumptions, and tests that pass without proving anything.

• Use AI assistants and agents for test design, test data, coverage analysis, failure triage and test maintenance, while keeping quality judgement under human control.

• Drive defects to root cause, and cover non-functional quality: performance, security-relevant behaviour, accessibility, reliability and observability.

• Communicate quality status, risk and release readiness clearly to engineers, architects and international customer stakeholders.

**What we are looking for**

•
**Minimum 7 years of hands-on professional testing and QA experience**
on real, delivered software.

• Demonstrable ownership of test strategy, test design techniques and methodology — not only test execution.

•
**Strong automation experience with Playwright and/or Selenium**
: framework structure, locator strategy,

synchronisation, parallel execution and flake control.

• Solid programming ability in at least one automation language (Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or C#), and practical API testing experience (REST, JSON, auth, contract testing).

• Comfortable with source control, CI/CD pipelines, and how modern applications are built — APIs, microservices, databases, cloud-native deployment — enough to test them below the surface.

•
**Strong spoken and written English**
, for working with international teams and clients.

• The temperament of a good colleague: curious, direct, collaborative, willing to challenge a spec or a design respectfully and with evidence — and a strong personal sense of ownership for what ships.

**Working in an AI-native development lifecycle (AIDLC)**

We do not expect years of experience testing agent-generated software — very few people have it. We do expect you to understand why it changes the job, and to want to master it: reading and interrogating specifications produced with GitHub Spec Kit, BMAD or comparable methodologies; treating a weak specification as a quality defect in its own right; using Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex or similar to accelerate test design and triage; knowing the characteristic failure modes of AI-generated tests — plausible assertions that verify nothing, missing negative paths, over-mocking, silent scope drift from the spec; and judging what is safe to delegate to an agent versus what a human must design. We care more about how you use AI to do quality engineering than which tool you have used.

**Additional advantages**

• Production use of AI assistants or agents in a QA workflow

• Testing AI, GenAI or agentic solutions (non-deterministic output)

• Performance and load testing (JMeter, k6, Gatling)

• Security-oriented testing / OWASP Top 10

• Contract testing, mocking, service virtualisation

• BDD and living documentation (Cucumber, SpecFlow)

• AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform

• Docker, Kubernetes, containerised test execution

• Event-driven architecture and messaging technologies

• Accessibility (WCAG) and cross-browser/device strategy

• Mobile test automation (Appium or equivalent)

• ISTQB or comparable certification

• Direct experience with international customers

• Knowledge of the German language

• Test data management at scale

**Why Bosenet?**

•
**Agentic engineering**
— AI agents as a normal part of delivery

•
**Spec-driven development**
— structured requirements, not vague tickets

•
**Modern architecture**
— cloud-native, microservices, integrations, APIs

•
**International exposure**
— customers in Germany and beyond

•
**Quality leadership**
— grow into test architecture and QA strategy

•
**Emerging AI solutions**
— AI and agents inside what we deliver

Eligible employees may also receive opportunities for client-site assignments in Germany, depending on project requirements, performance and applicable travel and visa conditions.

**Compensation**

**₹ 16–25 Lakhs CTC per annum**
. The range reflects the breadth of profiles we will consider. Compensation depends on relevant QA experience, depth of automation capability, programming and technical depth, ownership of test strategy, cloud-native and integration testing experience, AI-native testing maturity, communication and client-facing capability, and overall fit for the responsibility level. Exceptional strength in automation architecture, cloud-native quality engineering or AI-native testing is positioned towards the higher end.

**How to apply**

**Send us your resume**
,
**and briefly describe one real project where you owned the testing approach**
:

• What was being built, and what were the biggest quality risks?

• How did you design the test approach — and why that approach? What did you automate, with which tools, and what did you deliberately not automate?

• Which questions did you ask during requirements or specification discussions that changed the outcome?

• Have you used AI tools in your testing work? How — and how did you verify what they produced?

• What measurable difference did your work make to quality, escape rate or release confidence?

title: Applications Engineer - ICV Runset Development
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years in the trenches of physical verification, debugging LVS mismatches at 2 a.m. and hunting down obscure DRC violations that block tapeout. The difference between a runset that works and one that causes three weeks of respins is something you understand viscerally, and you are the engineer who catches the edge case before it becomes a customer escalation.
  
  
You are fluent in the language of foundries, process nodes, and design rules. When a new technology node drops, you do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the specs, write test cases, script your way through qualification, and deliver a working rule deck while others are still scheduling kickoff meetings. Perl, Tcl, and Python are not just tools for you, they are how you turn repetitive manual work into reliable automation.
  
  
Mentorship matters to you. You have seen junior engineers struggle with the same problems you solved years ago, and you take the time to walk them through it, not just hand them the answer. When a customer calls with a complex layout issue, you can translate their panic into a structured debug plan and explain the root cause in a way that makes sense to both the designer and the FAE.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work on IC Validator runsets for the most advanced process nodes in the industry, directly with foundries and customers who depend on what you build.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Develop and validate DRC, LVS, and Fill runsets for IC Validator, targeting advanced semiconductor process nodes from 7nm to 3nm and beyond
* Work directly with foundry partners to translate process design kits and manufacturing requirements into production-ready rule decks
* Automate runset qualification workflows using Perl, Tcl, and Python, reducing manual verification cycles and improving consistency across releases
* Debug complex layout verification failures, including LVS topology mismatches, DRC false positives, and DFM rule interactions that block customer tapeouts
* Interface with customers and field application engineers to gather requirements, reproduce issues, and deliver technical solutions that keep their projects on track
* Mentor junior engineers on PV best practices, IC Validator capabilities, and effective debugging techniques
* Track competitive EDA tools like Calibre and Pegasus, understanding their feature sets and how IC Validator differentiates in the market

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Enable first-pass silicon success for customers by delivering robust, accurate PV runsets that catch real issues without false noise
* Accelerate IC Validator adoption at top foundries and design houses, directly contributing to Synopsys revenue and market share in the PV space
* Reduce customer tapeout delays by providing fast, expert resolution to verification blockers that would otherwise cost weeks of schedule slip
* Build automation that scales across multiple process nodes and customer engagements, multiplying your impact beyond individual projects
* Shape the future roadmap of IC Validator by feeding real-world customer pain points and competitive insights back to the product development team
* Strengthen foundry partnerships through technical excellence and responsiveness, making Synopsys the go-to EDA partner for next-generation process nodes
* Grow the technical capability of the team by sharing knowledge, creating reusable scripts, and documenting solutions that become team standards

What You'll Need
  
  

* B.Tech, M.Tech, or MS in Electronics, VLSI, or related engineering discipline
* 5-8 years of hands-on experience in Physical Verification, with a focus on DRC, LVS, and Fill rule deck development
* Deep proficiency with IC Validator, Calibre, Pegasus, or PVS, you have written and debugged complex runsets in at least one of these tools
* Strong scripting skills in Perl, Tcl, and Python for automating PV workflows and qualification processes
* Solid understanding of CMOS transistor layouts, ASIC design flows, and how layout decisions impact manufacturability and yield
* Experience working with foundry PDKs and translating process rules into executable verification decks, exposure to sub-10nm nodes is a strong plus
* Familiarity with competitive EDA tools and the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs between different PV platforms

Who You Are
  
  

* You can take a 500-page foundry design manual and turn it into a working DRC deck without needing someone to hold your hand through every rule
* When an LVS run fails with 10,000 errors, you do not panic, you filter the noise, find the root cause, and fix it systematically
* You are comfortable on a call with a stressed customer two days before tapeout, walking them through a layout issue while keeping them confident the problem will get solved
* Mentoring is not a checkbox for you, when a junior engineer asks a question, you take the time to explain the why, not just the what
* You stay current on process technology and EDA tool developments because you are genuinely curious, not because it is in a performance goal
* You can manage three runset development projects, two customer escalations, and a foundry qualification cycle at the same time without dropping threads or missing deadlines

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will join a dynamic and diverse team of physical verification experts, tool developers, and field support engineers dedicated to enabling the next generation of semiconductor design. The team thrives on technical collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class PV solutions to customers worldwide. You will work closely with foundry partners, internal R&D, and field teams, ensuring that Synopsys remains a leader in EDA technology and customer satisfaction.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: R&D Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
* Principal Timing Signoff Engineer
* Principal Static Timing Analysis Engineer
* Principal Standard Cell Library Timing Engineer
* Principal STA Methodology Engineer
* Principal Library Signoff Architect
* We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent the better part of two decades chasing timing closure, and somewhere along the way you stopped thinking of signoff as a gate and started thinking of it as a prediction problem. You know that the difference between a library that works in a lab and one that ships in a million AI chips comes down to how well you modeled variation six months before tape-out. You have debugged enough customer escalations to recognize the smell of a characterization corner case, a parasitic extraction mismatch, or a setup check that looked fine until someone dropped VDD by 50 millivolts.
  
  
You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what the foundry gave you, what the characterization team extracted, and what the customer is seeing in their design, and you triangulate toward truth. You have built signoff flows that other engineers actually use, not because you mandated them, but because they solve real problems. You can sit in a room with a characterization engineer, a customer's STA lead, and a foundry PDK owner and walk out with a plan that everyone believes in.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work on standard cell libraries that power some of the most advanced semiconductor designs in production today. The problems are hard, the nodes are bleeding-edge, and the work you do will directly affect whether a chip meets its performance target or not.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own timing signoff methodology for standard cell libraries across TSMC N3, N2, N5, N7, and derivative nodes, defining setup, hold, recovery, removal, pulse-width, and noise margins that hold up in silicon
* Develop and validate multi-corner, multi-mode signoff flows for low-VDD, high-performance, and AI/compute SoCs, accounting for AOCV, POCV, SOCV, aging effects, and dynamic voltage drop
* Drive correlation analysis between Liberty models, PrimeTime STA results, HSPICE simulations, and silicon measurements to improve timing prediction accuracy and close signoff gaps
* Debug critical customer-reported timing issues, root-cause discrepancies between characterization, signoff, and deployment, and define corrective actions that prevent recurrence
* Build automation infrastructure in Python and Tcl to scale signoff validation, quality checks, and methodology deployment across multiple library releases
* Collaborate with characterization, CAD, modeling, EDA vendors, and foundry partners to influence signoff methodology direction and resolve advanced-node timing challenges
* Create technical documentation, best-practice guidelines, and deployment recommendations that internal teams and external customers rely on for signoff success

* The Impact You Will Have
* Your signoff methodologies will define how Synopsys standard cell libraries are validated and deployed across dozens of customer tape-outs on the most advanced nodes in production
* You will directly improve the accuracy of timing models that determine whether high-performance AI and compute chips meet their frequency, power, and yield targets
* Your correlation work will close the gap between what we predict in Liberty and what customers measure in silicon, reducing over-design margin and enabling better PPA
* You will resolve customer escalations that are blocking tape-out schedules, turning critical timing failures into understood, fixable methodology gaps
* Your automation and QA infrastructure will scale signoff validation across multiple nodes, reducing characterization cycle time and catching issues before libraries ship
* You will mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the bar for timing signoff expertise across the standard cell library development organization
* Your technical leadership will shape how Synopsys approaches variation-aware timing, low-VDD signoff, and advanced-node methodology for the next generation of process technologies
* What You'll Need
* 15+ years of semiconductor industry experience with significant depth in timing signoff, static timing analysis, and standard cell library development
* Recognized expertise in STA and signoff methodologies for advanced process nodes, ideally including direct experience with TSMC N7, N5, N3, or equivalent
* Deep hands-on proficiency with Synopsys PrimeTime, PrimeTime-SI, SiliconSmart or Liberate, HSPICE, Spectre, and FineSim
* Strong understanding of Liberty modeling, LVF, AOCV, POCV, SOCV, statistical timing, and variation-aware signoff techniques
* Proven track record defining and deploying signoff methodologies that have been adopted across multiple products, customers, or business units
* Expert-level automation skills in Python and Tcl, with experience building scalable signoff and QA infrastructure in Linux environments
* Experience correlating STA results, SPICE simulations, parasitic extraction, and silicon measurements to drive signoff accuracy and resolve discrepancies
* Who You Are
* You can look at a timing report with a 10ps violation and know within two questions whether it is a characterization issue, a parasitic problem, or a signoff methodology gap
* You have led root-cause investigations that spanned characterization, customer designs, foundry PDKs, and EDA tool behavior, and you know how to keep all those threads moving without losing momentum
* You are comfortable presenting signoff methodology recommendations to senior management, strategic customers, and foundry partners, and you can back up your position with data
* You push back when a characterization corner looks wrong or a signoff criterion does not match what you are seeing in silicon, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You have mentored engineers through complex timing correlation problems and helped them build the instinct for what matters and what is noise
* You treat customer escalations as learning opportunities, not interruptions, and you use them to make the next library release better
* The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the OpenBMC and platform management software that runs on AMD Adaptive SoC platforms. Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, firmware teams, and the OpenBMC open-source community, you will take new platforms from first power-on through to a supportable, upstreamable solution, and build the reference designs that AMD product teams and external customers adopt for their own platforms.

The ideal candidate is passionate about platform management software and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in OpenBMC and embedded Linux, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through platform bring-up and into production.
  
  
You are comfortable working across the full stack, from an I2C device to a Redfish endpoint, and have the communication skills to collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

* Strong embedded Linux background, including the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint: device trees, kernel configuration, driver enablement, and sysfs and hwmon.
* Working experience with the Yocto Project and OpenEmbedded — layers, recipes, and bbappends.
* Strong programming skills in C and C++, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning operating systems, drivers, firmware, and hardware, and familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.

* Platform security and root of trust: secure and measured boot, firmware signing, and attestation.
* Experience developing reference designs, demonstration platforms, or proof-of-concept solutions adopted by product teams or external customers.
* DC-SCM, DC-MHS, OCP, or other modular hardware and open compute standards.

title: Sr Staff High-Speed Interface Verification Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years in the trenches of mixed-signal verification, and you know that the hardest problems live at the boundary where digital meets analog. You are the engineer who can read a waveform, spot the timing violation that three others missed, and trace it back to a testbench assumption made two months ago. You do not just run regressions, you architect verification strategies that catch the subtle, the corner case, the thing that only shows up at 56 Gbps under specific PVT conditions.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead verification of high-speed SerDes IP using UVM and SystemVerilog testbenches in mixed-signal co-simulation environments
* Define, track, and execute verification test plans for PCIE, Ethernet, USB3.1, and other high-speed protocols from architecture through tapeout
* Debug simulation failures across digital and analog domains, working directly with waveform viewers, mixed-signal simulators, and protocol analyzers
* Build and extend UVM testbenches with constrained random sequences, coverage models, and checkers that target real-world corner cases
* Collaborate daily with digital, analog, and mixed-signal design teams to align verification strategy with design intent and silicon bring-up realities
* Manage customer escalations by reproducing issues, root-causing failures, and driving resolution with engineering and field teams
* Drive pre-sales and post-sales technical discussions with customers, translating verification results into confidence and clarity

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Ensure that SerDes IP shipping to customers meets performance, functionality, and reliability targets before it ever reaches silicon
* Reduce post-silicon debug cycles by catching mixed-signal integration issues early through rigorous co-simulation and coverage-driven verification
* Set the technical direction for verification methodology across current and next-generation SerDes products
* Accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction by resolving escalations quickly and providing clear, actionable technical guidance
* Mentor and elevate the verification team by establishing best practices, code reviews, and a culture of ownership and quality
* Contribute directly to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering verification environments that scale across protocol variants and process nodes
* Influence product roadmaps by surfacing verification insights that shape architecture and design decisions upstream

What You'll Need
  
  

* MTech or BTech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent with 7+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC or mixed-signal environments
* Deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and verification methodologies including constrained random testing, functional coverage, and assertions
* Proven experience with digital/analog co-simulation tools and methodologies, including AMS simulators and mixed-signal verification flows
* Working knowledge of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIE, Ethernet, or USB3.1, including protocol-level verification and compliance
* Strong understanding of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through RTL design, verification, and hardware bring-up
* Experience writing complex system-level testbenches in UVM, including sequence libraries, scoreboards, and protocol monitors
* Hands-on experience debugging waveform-level failures in both digital logic and analog circuit behavior

Who You Are
  
  

* You can walk into a room with analog designers discussing CDR loop dynamics and digital engineers debating clock domain crossings, and contribute meaningfully to both conversations
* You have managed customer escalations before and know how to balance urgency with thoroughness, reproducing the issue, isolating root cause, and communicating status without overselling or underselling
* You lead by setting the example, whether that is writing cleaner testbench code, asking the hard question in a design review, or staying late to close a critical bug before tapeout
* You make decisions with incomplete information, prioritize what matters, and course-correct when new data arrives without losing momentum
* You can explain a complex verification failure to a field applications engineer in two sentences and to a design lead in a ten-minute whiteboard session, adjusting depth and framing to the audience
* You build relationships across functions because you know that the best verification strategies come from understanding what design, applications, and customers actually need

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of a highly skilled team of digital, analog, and mixed-signal engineers responsible for delivering high-end mixed-signal designs from specification to implementation. This team thrives on collaboration, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver top-notch SerDes products to customers worldwide.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.
  
  

* Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.

* Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.

**What it's like to join at this level:**
You'll be a trusted operator on a team that is rebuilding how it works. You already know how to run production; here you'll take the hardest recurring problems, own them to root cause, and turn what you learn into runbooks, monitors, and automation the whole team uses. You'll manage escalations and support processes with guidance from senior leads, and you'll help the analysts around you get better.

You're curious, you want to know why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You can explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people, and you leave every system a little better documented and a little more automated than you found it.
  
  
What Are We Looking For?
  
  
As a Senior Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you'll independently own production support and administration for Salesforce's enterprise data and analytics platforms, with a strong grasp of native platform functionality and best practices. You'll help the team respond faster and resolve issues sooner, and you'll keep an eye on how satisfied our customers and partners are. You'll manage escalations across teams and time zones, act as a frontline responder who swarms incidents and knows when to pull in reliability engineers, own root-cause analysis through to resolution, and design monitoring that gives early warning. Escalation Management & Incident Response
  
  

* Own escalations on cases, intake, and investigations across teams and time zones: set priority, route to the right engineering, SRE, or vendor owner, drive them to closure, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Run follow-the-sun handoffs so escalations keep moving between Mexico City, Dublin, and Hyderabad without losing context.
* Track escalation trends (volume, repeat causes, time to engage, time to resolve), and bring them to leads and platform engineering to drive fixes.
* Be the escalation point for Tier-2 analysts on complex cases and investigations.
* Be a frontline responder in incidents: connect first, assess impact, and use judgment on when to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs). Manage the case, intake, and stakeholder communication workstream alongside Incident Command. SREs own incident resolution.
* Meet individual and team lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART), and case satisfaction (CSAT) targets while keeping backlog health. You are measured against the same targets as the team.
* Help L7 refine the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: mentor Systems Analysts on hitting them, and raise challenges where targets, routing, or processes make them hard to meet.
* Spot patterns in SLA misses and satisfaction feedback, and bring recommended fixes to the L7 and the team.

Problem Management & RCA Ownership
  
  

* Own root-cause analysis and resolution for application bugs and recurring failures, and close RCAs with verified fixes.
* Troubleshoot complex declarative and low-code issues, and recommend code-level fixes to engineering partners.
* Prioritize technical debt against the backlog to improve stability, and recommend fixes.

Reliability & Observability
  
  

* Design and implement proactive monitors, alerts, and automations for platform health.
* Contribute to design reviews and operating-model improvements (for example Operational Readiness practices).
* Use automation and AI to reduce manual work and move the team toward self-healing operations.

Platform Administration & Enhancement
  
  

* Deliver complex declarative solutions (Flows, validation rules, permission models) and manage enhancement projects from inception through support transition.
* Own complex access and role-hierarchy design, bulk data loads and migrations, and sandbox management.
* Reliably handle standard administration so the team can focus on higher-value work.

Process Engineering, SOPs & Support Reference Manuals
  
  

* Own process engineering for your platform area: templates, process design, capture, and lifecycle (create, review, update, retire) of lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs). This is process design, not technical writing.
* Request SRM inputs from Platform Engineering and create or manage them as needed, so support teams have the reference material they need before launch.
* Keep SOPs and SRMs current and findable, and use them to reduce repeat escalations.
* Write knowledge articles and business process maps that let Tier-1/Tier-2 teams resolve issues without escalation.
* Act as SME and point of contact for development and product partners.

Security, SOX & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain compliance with security policies and change controls.
* Support technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX controls, and help close findings.
* Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.

Collaboration & Growth
  
  

* Partner effectively with vendors, engineers, and business teams across time zones.
* Mentor Systems Analysts and new joiners, and share knowledge through documentation and team forums.
* Try new tools and practices, and bring ideas that improve how the team works.

Flexibility

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or equivalent experience.
* 0-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support, administration, or implementation experience in an enterprise IT environment.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce native functionality and best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage escalations across teams and time zones, respond as a frontline responder in incidents (including knowing when to pull in reliability engineers), and own RCAs through resolution.
* Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules), data loading, and troubleshooting complex data and configuration issues.
* Working knowledge of Service Management practices (incident, problem, change) and the SDLC.
* Ability to design lightweight processes, SOPs, and reference manuals that others can run.

**Process Overview**
Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role is for GIS Penetration testing team to conduct penetration tests and source code reviews of our internal/external web, mobile, web, and web API service applications, leveraging both manual techniques as well as automated tools to uncover and report security vulnerabilities that exist.
  
  
You must be knowledgeable with business risks associated to common security vulnerabilities and to be able to effectively communicate complex technical concepts such as security vulnerabilities to application developers and/or senior managers who may have little to no experience with application security.
  
  
You must have the ability to work independently in a very large scale, enterprise setting and collaborate with peer team members. Previous experience as an application security professional with a large Financial Institution a plus.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Performs assigned analysis of internal and external threats on information systems and predict future threat behavior
* Incorporates threat actors' tactics, techniques, and procedures into offensive security testing
* Performs assessments of the security, effectiveness, and practicality of multiple technology systems
* Leverages innovative thinking to help solve problems or introduce new ideas to processes or products applicable to offensive security
* Prepares and presents detailed technical information for various media including documents, reports, and notifications
* Provides clear and practical advice regarding managed risks
* Learns and develops advanced technical and leadership skills; Mentor Junior assessors in technical tradecraft and soft skill

**Requirements**
**Education:**
B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech
  
  
**Certifications, If Any:**
GWAPT, CEH, OSCP, SANS, CEH
  
  
**Experience Range:**
6+ years
